interval_method: Two-sided 95% Wilson intervals are used for action and unconditional false-adapt counts. Conditional false-adapt reports a one-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound from false-adapt events over ADAPT decisions; it is undefined when ADAPT=0.
